name: Traffic
description: Cars, taxis and buses with headlights driving the street network, and now and then an emergency vehicle

about.purpose: Brings streets to life with moving traffic, so people read the street network and how busy it feels.
questions: Which streets carry traffic, and how would calmer streets feel?
